A ''' vessel''' was the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of notorious [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jon Arco]], both of which had disappeared in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Arco's old astrogation charts were later used to pinpoint his ship and recover his riches.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|A Pirate's Legacy}}</ref>
